file_change.purpose: Define the minimum durable Build mutation evidence required for Plan-scope Conformance and Governance lineage.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for build identity, accepted Plan identity, actor, implementation predecessor, Build-start state, resulting candidate state, and observed mutations.
Each mutation records one unique repository-relative path and observed create, modify, delete, or regenerate operation.
Require repository-relative safe paths and prohibit absolute, parent-traversal, or duplicate path/operation entries.
Do not require generated-consequence relationships or other deferred evidence-orchestration metadata in FS0-Core.
